name: Earth electrode
summary: A conductor in contact with the ground, such as a driven rod, providing the installation's connection to earth.
description: The earth electrode symbol marks a rod, plate, tape or foundation electrode that makes contact with the general mass of the earth. It appears on earthing diagrams and site layouts, often numbered so that individual electrodes can be tested and recorded.

The symbol does not tell you the electrode resistance, length, material or depth. Those come from the earthing design and test records. Multiple electrodes drawn together are only effective if spaced appropriately; electrodes too close together share the same soil and add less than expected.
readingNotes: Read electrode numbering for test records.
distinction: An earth electrode is the physical contact with soil; an earth connection symbol is any connection to the earthing system.
